ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-1,
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 3-I in the

area bound by:

the alley next north of and parallel to West Division Street; a line 253.36 feet west of and
parallel to North Rockwell Street; West Division Street; and, a line 278.36 feet west of
and parallel to North Rockwell Street

to those of a B2-5, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Jessig’Fuentes WA
Aldefwoman, 26” Ward

Common Address:
2626 West Division Street
